summary: @fleetbo/svro ships heavily obfuscated postinstall script combined with child_process + HTTP POST behavior
details: The package ships two heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundles at dist/postinstall.cjs and dist/cli.cjs (identifier-mangled string-array obfuscation typical of javascript-obfuscator output). The corresponding non-obfuscated dist/postinstall.js and dist/cli.js contain child_process usage combined with HTTP POST calls. The postinstall bundle runs automatically on npm install via the package's lifecycle hook, executing obfuscated code that spawns subprocesses and performs outbound HTTP POST requests on the installer's machine. Obfuscation of code that runs at install time and combines process execution with network exfiltration primitives is not consistent with a legitimate build or bootstrap step for a package of this scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
